about.description: Klima DAO is a governance and incentive token for its protocol ecosystem, enabling community decision-making and participation in protocol economics. It aligns stakeholder interests through tokenized governance.
about.registryInfo: Klima DAO (decentralized autonomous organization, no formal entity; operated by community contributors). Launched October 2021 with the mission to drive carbon-credit prices higher and accelerate climate action. KLIMA token backed by carbon-credit reserves (BCT, MCO2, NCT, UBO, NBO) bridged from Verra registry via Toucan and Moss.Earth.

fees.revenueNotes: Klima DAO captures revenue through: (1) Bonding mechanism — when carbon credits are bonded into the protocol, the DAO wallet receives an additional 30% of the bond's value in KLIMA on top of the bonder's allocation (i.e., on a 10 KLIMA bond, 10 goes to the bonder and 3 to the DAO). (2) Trading/retirement fee of up to 1% on carbon token trades and retirements through Klima infrastructure. (3) LP-revenue capture on KLIMA pairs. Staking rewards distribute 70% of seigniorage to KLIMA stakers and 30% to DAO operations. Source: https://docs.klimadao.finance/references/glossary
